[
  {
    "id": "houserules.actions-default-shell-lacks-pipefail",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "An Actions run step with no shell key runs bash -e without pipefail: a failing left side of a pipe passes silently; name shell: bash for -eo pipefail."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.actions-pinned-by-sha",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Pin every workflow `uses:` to a full commit SHA, version tag as a comment; the Actions policy rejects a tag ref; release.yml pins live in dist-workspace.toml."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.corpus-batch14-fixtures-are-committed",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "tests/fixtures/batch14-workspace/ commits gitignored .superpowers/ batch-14 deliverables verbatim, host paths neutralized."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.crash-paths-are-named",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "rust",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Where the frozen JS crashed or a glob/regex fails to compile, the binary reports one named error or finding — never a reproduced crash, never a silent default."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.default-token-tags-start-no-workflows",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A tag or commit pushed with the default GITHUB_TOKEN triggers no workflow; a release hand-off needs a PAT/App token or an explicit workflow_dispatch hop."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.dev-tools-are-rust-native",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Dev tooling is a cargo bin under crates/houserules/src/bin/; never a new Node script."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.glob-union-matcher",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "rust",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "RETIRED at batch 20 T3: tools/kb.mjs's own globMatch union is gone; crates/houserules/src/rules/glob.rs's globset engine is the only matcher left."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.live-run-recipe",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "cli",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Live-run every CLI change in a scratch `git init` repo: `init --dir <scratch>`, both checks inside; each gate its own `live_run` entry with `exit`."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.node-under-mise",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "RETIRED at batch 20 T3 (HR-047): node and pnpm left mise.toml entirely once the JS toolchain retired; this PATH trap no longer applies to either tool."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.path-pins-mirror-the-code",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "rust",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A test that pins a path the binary prints builds it component by component: Path::join keeps an embedded slash, and Windows alone shows the divergence."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.payload-runs-on-builtins",
    "kind": "invariant",
    "area": "template",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "The vendored payload runs on the `houserules` binary and POSIX shell only: every shipped reference invokes it directly; no file needs Node, npm, or an install."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.pinned-shas-live-on-mains-ancestry",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A committed test or fixture that pins a git sha must pin one on main's ancestry, proven reachable in a fresh clone."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.platform-gated-tests",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "rust",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Gate platform-specific code with #[cfg]: a std::os::unix or std::os::windows use compiles only on that platform; CI builds all targets on three OSes."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.pnpm-only",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Use cargo for every package operation in this repository (`cargo add <crate>@=<version>`); pnpm, npm, and npx left the toolchain at batch 20 T3."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.post-release-restamp",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "After a release-please PR merge, run update --dir ., commit the restamp, and push; see docs/runbook.md."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.readme-mirrors-kit-owned",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "When `KIT_OWNED` gains or loses a path, update README's agent-layer bullet and ownership table in the same commit."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.release-please-schema-gap",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "release-please's config JSON schema omits prerelease-type and skip-snapshot from its root; keep those settings under the package entry."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.release-workflow-is-generated",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "release.yml is generated from dist-workspace.toml; never hand-edit it — edit the config and run `dist generate` (`dist generate --check` is the gate)."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.rename-map",
    "kind": "decision",
    "area": "template",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Relative to tag-pilot: unprefixed agent and skill names, `project-knowledge` skill, `dependency_vetting` for field `a19`, parameterized id prefix."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.rust-toolchain-bumps-use-stable",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Bump rust with `V=$(mise latest rust) && mise use --pin rust@$V` — stable's newest, resolved by the CLI, exact in mise.toml; keep the components table."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.tag-pilot-is-read-only",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Treat the tag-pilot checkout outside this repository as read-only: never modify it, commit there, run its agents, or run `init` or `update` against it."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.template-is-the-source",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Edit the kit in `template/`, then run `houserules update --dir .`; never hand-edit the root copies or the generated rules and skill."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.tests-clean-scratch-dirs",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Every test that mints a scratch directory registers its removal at the mkdtemp site: `tempfile::TempDir`'s own Drop, or an equivalent Drop-owning guard."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.vitest-coverage-floor-tracks-the-rust-port",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "RETIRED at batch 20 T3: the vitest ratchet ended with vitest itself; cargo's suites are the ongoing gate, with no coverage threshold of their own."
  },
  {
    "id": "houserules.vitest-restore-mocks-scope",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "RETIRED at batch 20 T3 (HR-047): vitest left the repository entirely, and with it every `vi.mock`/`vi.spyOn` call site this gotcha governed."
  },
  {
    "id": "knowledge-base.cite-durable-refs",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Cite a commit in a permanent file only if it is or will be reachable from main; name in-branch events by batch/task/round; restate interim SHAs at aggregation."
  },
  {
    "id": "knowledge-base.ids-are-permanent",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Never rename a merged entry id. Add a new entry and link the old one with `see`."
  },
  {
    "id": "knowledge-base.rules-need-a-loading-path",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Give every rule, invariant, or checked entry a loading path: `standing: true`, or an area whose globs match the files it governs."
  },
  {
    "id": "knowledge-base.state-only-the-source",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "State only what the source states; verify polarity, counts, and mechanisms against the code before filing an entry or shipping teaching prose."
  },
  {
    "id": "knowledge-base.summary-is-the-rule",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "The `summary` states the rule in one sentence; `body` carries why, how, exceptions; examples in docs and skills model this split. No time-sensitive phrasing."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.ask-when-missing",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Ask the user when information is missing. Do not assume."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.backlog-drives-work",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "The backlog drives all work. Select backlog items before you start; every requirement traces to an item."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.brainstorm-first",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Start each batch with a brainstorming session or a written spec; get the user's approval before implementing."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.brief-carries-the-spec",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A task brief carries every test, gate, and file its spec task names; an implementer who cannot satisfy one flags it instead of dropping it."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.claims-match-artifacts",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Before submitting a report, re-open every artifact a claim cites and confirm the artifact shows what the sentence says."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.closure-claims-carry-enumeration",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "A claim that a set is closed ('every', 'all', 'no remaining') names the bounded, rerunnable enumeration that produced it; without the artifact, no claim."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.code-health-scan",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Every plan carries a code-health scan of the files the batch touches: name the smells and antipatterns found, and fold targeted fixes into the tasks."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.contract-refresh-sweep",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A contract change migrates every earlier report in-batch: a report-only refresh round per task, a scoped re-review, and scripted checks for mechanical fixes."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.conventional-commits",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Commits use Conventional Commits (feat, fix, chore, test, ci, docs, refactor). Header at most 100 characters, body lines at most 100."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.deliverables-json",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Task reports, reviews, and branch reviews are JSON files that pass `houserules validate` against `.claude/schemas/deliverables.json`."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.eval-fixture-procedure",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Seeded-violations fixtures follow fixed steps: seed violations in the eval worktree, doctor the report to hide only those fail rows, keep the true audit aside."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.evals-rerun",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "docs",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Re-run every `.claude/evals/` scenario when the implementer or task-reviewer template or a scenario changes; append the run to `.claude/evals/record.json`."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.every-main-commit-is-ci-green",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "No commit that lands on main may fail the ci.yml checked in beside it; sequence a migration's deletions or collapse the red range at aggregation."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.evidence-outlives-the-session",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Cite evidence only at paths that outlive the session: the batch workspace or the tracked tree, never a session scratchpad."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.ff-only-merges",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Merge fast-forward only, from the CLI, after aggregating the branch into clean logical commits. No merge commits, no GitHub squash merges."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.gate-shell-chains",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Chain every evidence-producing shell sequence with && or explicit exit checks; an unchained tail after a heredoc reports success for a command that never ran."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.keep-knowledge-current",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Add knowledge future sessions need to `knowledge/`; session memory is not portable, repo files are."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.knowledge-first",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Before you change a file, read its knowledge: the ids in your task and `houserules for <path>`. Cite the ids you relied on in your report."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.live-run-before-ci",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Verify a change live (run the app, service, or tool for real; capture evidence) before any PR, merge, or deploy spend."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.main-wins-backlog-collisions",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "On a backlog collision with main, main wins: rebuild the branch on it by cherry-pick, drop the never-merged branch filings, and park superseded analysis."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.model-policy",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Every review runs on a mightier model than the implementer it reviews. Implementers use the cheapest model that fits the task."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.no-tech-debt",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Fix every review finding, Minor included. Defer a fix only for a stated reason, as a backlog item; never as a TODO in code."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.owner-content-mid-batch",
    "kind": "procedure",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Owner content found uncommitted on the shared tree mid-batch: commit it verbatim as its own commit, surface concerns instead of editing, record its position."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.review-findings-are-claims-too",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "A review finding stating a measurement, a reproduction, or a proposed fix's behavior is verified by running it before filing; restated claims are re-derived."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.rulings-to-file",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Every ruling goes to its home file in the same turn — a deferral’s backlog item included. A ledger and the chat are not home files; neither survives compaction."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.sequential-agents",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Run all agent work strictly sequentially. Never dispatch two implementers or two reviewers at the same time."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.skills-for-procedures",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Create a project skill (`.claude/skills/`) for a repeatable procedure. Author it with the writing-skills skill when available."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.tdd",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Test-driven development for every executable change: the failing test first, or a disclosed-mutation proof for already-correct behavior; verbatim RED and GREEN."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.verify-in-persisted-state",
    "kind": "gotcha",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Verify behavior against the persisted state the code reads in production; a one-off override is a different state and can falsify the measurement."
  },
  {
    "id": "process.wiring-checks-run-the-resolution",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tools",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A trigger, pin, or wiring check runs the resolution end to end - feed the produced value to its consumer; a string, glob, or schema match proves nothing."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.absence-is-designed",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "cli",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Render an absent value in user-facing output as a designed token; never let a raw undefined, null, or empty slot reach the user."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.gates-derive-their-scope",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "rust",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "A permanent gate derives its scope (tracked files minus declared, reasoned exclusions) and fails loudly on unreadable input; a hand-typed list is ungated."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.no-compat-softening",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Never soften a design for backward compatibility. Make the correct change and migrate everything it breaks; the codebase is not built on compromises."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.pin-copies-byte-exact",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "tests",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "Pin a hand-synced copy byte-exact modulo its one designed difference, expressed as the production transform; never normalize by deleting the differing field."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.principles",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "YAGNI, KISS, DRY; prefer a well-maintained library to custom code; one responsibility per unit; tests assert behavior; a11y and i18n are part of done."
  },
  {
    "id": "quality.well-maintained-libraries",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "process",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Use well-maintained libraries over custom code. The orchestrator researches candidates at spec time; the owner rules the choice; refactors fold into specs."
  },
  {
    "id": "security-hygiene.dependency-vetting",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Verify every new dependency is well-maintained before adding it. Record the check in the task report's `dependency_vetting` field."
  },
  {
    "id": "security-hygiene.exact-pins",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Pin exact versions. Install only with a CLI (`cargo add <crate>@=<version>`, `pnpm add --save-exact`). Never write a version number by hand."
  },
  {
    "id": "security-hygiene.no-coauthor",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Never add a co-author, session, or tool-attribution line to any commit or pull request description."
  },
  {
    "id": "security-hygiene.no-focused-tests",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Never commit a focused test (`.only(`)."
  },
  {
    "id": "security-hygiene.verify-current-docs",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Verify every library, tool, and framework API against current docs before use. Internal knowledge is stale."
  },
  {
    "id": "writing-style.code-comments",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Write a code comment only for a constraint the code cannot show."
  },
  {
    "id": "writing-style.doc-comments",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Document every exported symbol with the language's doc-comment convention. Name things so the code reads without comments."
  },
  {
    "id": "writing-style.instructions-cover-the-state-space",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "template",
    "standing": false,
    "summary": "An instruction keyed to one value of an enumerated field names the value it displaces; test the sentence against every other value before shipping."
  },
  {
    "id": "writing-style.principles",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Write docs, comments, commit messages, and reports in ASD-STE100 style: short sentences, active voice, one instruction per sentence, concise."
  }
]
